title: I’m building Grand Gambit — chess meets card strategy, with AI-generated card artwork
author: Auberon-XIII
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m working on **Grand Gambit**, a strategy game combining chess, deckbuilding, and historical commanders.

The attached video shows **30 seconds of gameplay from the Unreal Engine version**. Your deck adds another layer of decisions to the chessboard, with cards that support your pieces and help shape your strategy.

**Players in the Unreal Engine version can play against people using the browser version.** Both versions connect to the same game, so you can play together across clients.

The Unreal Engine version isn’t ready for release yet, but **you can already play the browser version here:**

[**Play Grand Gambit**](https://grandgambit.cards)

Since this is r/aigamedev: **AI was used to generate the card artwork**, including artwork featuring historical commanders such as Sun Tzu and Alexander the Great.

I’d love to hear what you think of the gameplay and visual style. If you try the browser version, feedback on the rules, card interactions, and anything confusing would be especially helpful.

Thanks for checking it out!
